title: HelioFITS Studio
description: HelioFITS Studio is a desktop viewer for solar and heliospheric imagery, built around coronagraph and wide-field data. It is an unofficial fork of JHelioviewer, the open-source solar image browser of the ESA/NASA Helioviewer Project, that adds tools for the outer corona: PUNCH and native LASCO data loading, the Helioradial projections, the RHEF radial histogram equalizing filter, CME tracking against the CACTus catalog, point cloud layers and deep-colour movie export. Files that came from JHelioviewer keep their licence and notices.
